About Betfair Romania Development
 Betfair Romania Development is the largest technology hub of Flutter Entertainment, with over 2,000 people powering the world’s leading sports betting and iGaming brands.  About Sportsbet
 Sportsbet is the market leader in the Australian online sports betting market. The brand features innovative, easy to use products and personalized value, making it a favourite among users.
 Our Values

 Win together | Raise the bar | Got your back | Own it | Positive impact
 Role Overview
 We are looking for a Senior Data Engineer to join our Data team, working for Sportsbet Australia. The role is available in Cluj-Napoca, Romania.
The Senior Data Engineer is a key role within Data Platforms, responsible for delivering innovative and sustainable data-driven solutions to provide Sportsbet a competitive advantage in the market.
 Project Delivery
 Key Accountabilities & Responsibilities:
Analyze and question business requirements.
Independently deliver medium-high complexity features/tasks end‑to‑end
Independently analyse problems and identify constraints/dependencies; raise risks early and propose mitigations
Actively contribute to the solution design.
Accurately estimate effort and hold yourself and others accountable for delivery.
Develop high quality, high performing code which meets the business need.
Continuously improve our platforms/services with each release - new initiatives are an opportunity to deliver faster than last time.
Optimize platforms/solutions to ensure we support our service levels and minimize spend.
Identify gaps and implement best practices across operational processes, DevOps, deployments etc.
Promote the production of reusable code and modules where appropriate with a view to maximizing effort and reducing development costs
Write clean, maintainable solutions; use standards, reviews, and testing practices to sustain quality.
Write clean, maintainable changes aligned to team standards; contribute to improving team practices through feedback and suggestions.
Automate processes wherever possible.
Innovate and challenge the status quo by introducing new ideas and concepts to the team.
 Platform Operations
Support what we build - taking ownership of production issues, working with stakeholders through to resolution.
Identify, escalate and mitigate operational risks.
Conduct regular performance tuning across our platforms to ensure optimal usage of resources.
Perform regular maintenance and audit activities (patches, upgrades, user access reviews, DR tests etc.) as required to ensure stability.
Identify and act on opportunities for automation.
 Skills, Capabilities & Experience Required
Broad experience with AWS technologies (e.g. MSK, AWS Glue, AWS Lambda, AWS Step Functions, CloudWatch, Athena, Fargate, S3, EMR, etc.)
Advanced SQL skills across relational and NoSQL systems
5+ years hands-on experience with Python, Spark or PySpark
3+ years' experience working with Databricks and modern Lakehouse frameworks
Proficiency in CI/CD pipelines and deployment automation (Jenkins, Ansible, shell scripting, unit/integration/performance testing)
Experience using AI coding assistants/tools (GitHub Copilot, AWS Q, Databricks Genie, Cursor) to improve development efficiency
Experience with serverless-based technologies
Experience with data‑streaming architectures (Kafka/MSK, Kinesis, Spark Streaming)
Strong understanding of systems analysis, component-based system design and modern software development principles
 Nice To Have
Exposure to Data Vault Modelling and Delta Lake architectures
Experience working in fast paced agile environments with modern development practices
Test-driven development techniques
